_purpose: Test exploration mechanics, unknown territory discovery, environmental challenges without predetermined solutions, artifact interaction risks, information control decisions (what to report?), mapping/surveying, Pilot/Investigation/Attunement synergy
_comment_tactical: === TACTICAL MODULE - ENABLED (Unknown Hazards May Include Combat) ===
_scenario_hint: Uncharted Moon Mu-12 (void_level unknown, pre-Covenant ruins detected), team hired by Tempest to survey, map, and assess commercial/research value. Unknown challenges: unstable terrain, ancient security systems, alien ecosystem, pre-Covenant artifacts with unpredictable effects, reality distortions. Discovery opportunities: technology, historical records, Seed deposits, void phenomena. Information control: what to report to Tempest? What to suppress? What to sell to highest bidder? Each faction wants different intel (Tempest: void tech, Nexus: suppress dangerous knowledge, Freeborn: liberate discoveries). Exploration tests: Pilot (navigation, terrain traversal), Investigation (mapping, analysis), Attunement (artifact interaction), Systems (tech reverse-engineering), Awareness (hazard detection).

_design_notes.ml_training_value: Exploration/discovery gameplay, unknown territory mapping, environmental challenges without predetermined solutions, artifact interaction with unpredictable effects, information control decisions (factional loyalty vs. profit vs. public good), surveying mechanics (Investigation + Pilot + Systems synergy), unknown hazard management, discovery-driven narrative (DM improvises based on PC exploration choices)
_design_notes.character_innovation: Pilot specialist (navigation, ship ops), archaeologist (Investigation 6, artifact analysis), attunement specialist (interface with ancient tech), comprehensive surveying equipment

starting_clocks.name: Territory Mapping
starting_clocks.description: Moon surface surveyed and documented. At 10 ticks: comprehensive map complete, commercial value assessed.

starting_clocks.name: Artifact Activation Risk
starting_clocks.description: Interaction with pre-Covenant technology. At 5 ticks: artifact partially activated. At 8 ticks: full activation (consequences unknown).
starting_clocks.regress_meaning: artifact activation risk setback or reversal

starting_clocks.name: Tempest Rival Expedition Arrival
starting_clocks.description: Competing expedition ETA. At 0 ticks: rivals arrive, claim contested discoveries.
starting_clocks.advance_meaning: tempest rival expedition arrival worsens or time runs out
starting_clocks.regress_meaning: tempest rival expedition arrival improves or delayed

starting_clocks.name: Discovery Significance
starting_clocks.description: Major findings accumulated. At 12 ticks: paradigm-shifting discovery (void origin? Dissolution truth? Ancient civilization evidence?).

players.name: Expedition Pilot Arden Vex
goals: Navigate moon terrain safely and map territory
Decide what discoveries to report to Tempest vs. sell independently
Profit from expedition while maintaining autonomy

players.name: Archaeologist Lyss Kain
goals: Study pre-Covenant ruins for historical/scientific value
Publish findings to advance understanding (vs. suppress knowledge)

players.name: Artifact Interface Specialist Kael Rift
goals: Activate and reverse-engineer ancient artifacts for Tempest
Discover void technology or pre-Covenant power sources
Take calculated risks with artifact activation

notes: ML Training Focus: Exploration/discovery mechanics in unknown territory, environmental challenges without predetermined solutions (DM improvises based on player choices), artifact interaction with unpredictable effects (Attunement + Systems checks, risk/reward), information control decisions (report to Tempest? Sell to rivals? Publish publicly?), mapping/surveying (Investigation + Pilot synergy), terrain traversal (Athletics + Pilot), unknown hazard management (Awareness + Science), factional information brokering. Tests underrepresented exploration gameplay, discovery-driven narrative, environmental storytelling, artifact analysis, information control ethics, surveying skill synergies. Long campaign (20 turns) allows thorough exploration, multiple discoveries, artifact experimentation, rival competition tension, information control drama. Features Pilot 6 (navigation specialist), Investigation 6 + Science 6 (archaeologist), Attunement 6 + Astral Arts 6 (artifact interface), comprehensive surveying gear (terrain scanners, analysis kits, translation databases). Pre-Covenant mystery allows ML training on speculative discovery responses.
